(MarijuanaNews note: I am posting this as a warning to medical marijuana users in the Sacramento area, but also as an alert to everyone who thinks that the police should obey the law. What they are doing is illegal and dangerous to everyone’s freedom.)
See
Selective Enforcement Versus Selective Compliance – 2 Articles
and
What Part Of 'Exempt' Do California District Attorneys Still Not Understand?

From California NORML
May 4, 2000
Sheriffs deputies are continuing to spy on and raid medical marijuana patients who patronize the Greenfire garden store in Sacramento.

Jamie Pelton, a patient in Garden Valley, was just visited by the El Dorado County sheriffs deputies two weeks after visiting Greenfire.

She let the deputies in without a warrant and showed them her recommendation. She was not charged because she hadn't started cultivating yet. However, the deputies told her that she would have to call them back to inspect her garden, and that she was only entitled to six plants, three of which could be blooming.
(MarijuanaNews note: There is no such limit under Prop 215. The police are violating the law and should be prosecuted.)

Jamie reports that another patient was also just raided by El Dorado deputies shortly after visiting Greenfire. The deputies took away some of the patient's plants so as to leave only six.

In both cases, the deputies appear to have located the patients through the license registrations of their cars. Jamie reports that when the deputies arrived at her home, they called for her husband by a name that he uses only on his DMV registration.

It therefore appears that police are monitoring the license plates of Greenfire customers. The Sacramento News and Review ran a feature about medical marijuana busts of Greenfire customers earlier this year.

Maybe it's time for someone to post warning signs outside Greenfire warning customers that they may be under surveillance!!!!
(MarijuanaNews note: Maybe it is time to post warning signs outside of the Attorney General’s office warning Californian’s that he can’t control the narks.)
